critical_code_review_comments: routers/posts.list_posts depends on `?viewer=<username>` query param (not the Authorization header) to determine viewer_id for my_reaction. Two clients could miss this and get my_reaction=null even when authenticated. Consider falling back to the bearer-token user if `?viewer` is absent.
_target_exists in reactions.py performs a Mongo lookup on every set call. Fine, but if the surface grows hot consider a small TTL cache.
